measurements.scope: Five real single-schema datasets; original SpecSon Twitter import excluded in favor of clean reimport. Storage uses each engine native dataset allocation. GIN build and schema registration reported separately.

storage_measurement.scope: Native dataset storage including required indexes and document external storage; pg excludes measured GIN forks, pg-gin includes them when present. SpecSON and SpecSON-TOAST share schema storage, counted once separately.

measurements.scope: SpecSON storage excludes the shared schema store; insertion excludes schema registration. jsonb+GIN insertion adds the separately measured index build.
